we introduce a novel concept of data statistics management, namely, constraint data statistics and implied integrity constraints, and we demonstrate its effectiveness and applicability in a commercial database system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
constraint data statistics are a novel, effective and efficient way to improve data quality, and to optimize and accelerate database query processing.

data statistics management in the SAP HANA in-memory database can be extended with constraint data statistics, which can be leveraged in the database optimizer to generate implied integrity constraints, which are then used for dynamic partition management.
